quarterly_data.signal: As of July 31, 2026 Keysight's non-cancellable commitments to contract manufacturers and suppliers were $704 million versus $450 million as of October 31, 2025, and total commitments to contract manufacturers and suppliers were $762 million versus $487 million, the increase primarily driven by advance purchase orders placed to support fulfillment of a strong order backlog. A risk factor states Keysight has experienced a substantial increase in order volumes which, combined with manufacturing capacity constraints and ongoing supply chain challenges, could result in extended lead times for new orders and in some cases shipping delays. Keysight expects capital spending of approximately $160 million in 2026, primarily for investments in capacity expansion and technology investments.
quarterly_data.figure: non-cancellable CM/supplier commitments $704 million (vs $450 million); total commitments $762 million (vs $487 million); 2026 capex ~$160 million

quarterly_data.signal: Remaining performance obligations (excluding contracts with an original expected duration of one year or less) were approximately $616 million as of July 31, 2026, with 21 percent expected to be fulfilled during the remainder of 2026, 43 percent during 2027 and 36 percent thereafter.

Commercial communications end market revenue represented 75 percent of Communications Solutions Group revenue in the three months ended July 31, 2026; for the nine months it increased 43 percent year over year and represented 71 percent of CSG revenue. Growth was primarily driven by customer R&D spend in terabit solutions and expanding 400G/800G/1.6 terabit transceiver manufacturing capacity to meet rising AI demand, which drove demand for Keysight's 400G/800G/1.6 terabit Ethernet solutions in both R&D and manufacturing.
quarterly_data.figure: commercial communications 75% of CSG revenue in the quarter; nine months +43% YoY (71% of CSG revenue)
